name: Kanye Rest
tagline: Simple random Kanye West quote API for demos and fun apps
description: Kanye Rest is a free, no-auth novelty API that returns a random Kanye West quote as JSON. The classic endpoint is a single GET that responds with a short quote object, making it a common demo choice for teaching HTTP, JSON parsing, and browser fetch. It is minimal by design: one resource, no account, and no published commercial plans, so it suits prototypes and teaching—not production-critical workloads.

auth.details: No authentication required; public GET endpoints work without keys or signup.

pricing.free_tier_limits: Fully free with no signup; no published request quota

example.response_snippet: {"quote":"I feel like I'm too busy writing history to read it."}

use_cases: fetch a random Kanye West quote as JSON
demo HTTP GET and JSON parsing in tutorials
seed placeholder text with celebrity quotes
test CORS-enabled browser fetch against a public API
power a novelty quote widget or bot reply
